known_live_failures.failure_mode: Live-accepted transitional Entry Agent and Trade Manager wrappers were classified as FOREIGN because only direct child command lines were recognized.
known_live_failures.permanent_regression: Governed transitional and canonical wrapper identities are authenticated by wrapper bytes, child bytes, ancestry model, port ownership, and readiness independently.
known_live_failures.full_cycle_integration_point: Initial production-like partial topology and first confirmed START preserve trusted transitional wrappers; confirmed shutdown clears them; restart establishes two canonical wrappers.

known_live_failures.failure_mode: Multiple python.exe applications produced a System.Object[] that could not be passed to Start-Process -FilePath.
known_live_failures.permanent_regression: Python 3.12 AMD64 resolution rejects WindowsApps aliases, requires one validated scalar path, and fails closed on two equally authoritative candidates.
known_live_failures.full_cycle_integration_point: Every real open_command_center.cmd invocation runs with both a governed Python and a visible WindowsApps alias before the full control cycle.

known_live_failures.failure_mode: Healthy Trade Manager /trades responses at approximately 2020-2140 ms exceeded the former 2000 ms safety timeout.
known_live_failures.permanent_regression: The authoritative /trades read uses a 4000 ms attempt timeout, one timeout-only retry, and an 8000 ms shared fail-closed budget.
known_live_failures.full_cycle_integration_point: Runs 1-3 use process-backed /trades responses delayed 2140 ms, 2036 ms, and 2020 ms during real confirmed control operations.

known_live_failures.failure_mode: The Python backend reported control generation r1c while the PowerShell launcher still expected r1a.
known_live_failures.permanent_regression: PowerShell and Python derive the control version from one tracked manifest and authenticate the same generation hashes and deployment/rollback set.
known_live_failures.full_cycle_integration_point: Every initial and repeated operator open performs the shared-authority handshake; the upgrade cycle changes only that authority and rejects the stale host.

known_live_failures.failure_mode: ControlManager.arm() started the five-second confirmation deadline before synchronously collecting the production pre-state snapshot; Entry and Trade readiness latency consumed the entire operator-visible window.
known_live_failures.production_evidence: COMMAND_CENTER_R2_FINAL_EVIDENCE_20260812_071332_START_CONFIRMATION_PRESTATE_LATENCY_SAFE_STOP_V1.zip; immediate confirmation returned confirmation_missing_or_expired and no operation UUID was created.
known_live_failures.correction: Phase-A read-only preflight and durable audit complete before the monotonic Phase-B arm clock begins; Phase-C confirmation remains session/action/version bound and reruns all action safety gates.
known_live_failures.permanent_regression: Latency matrix 0-7500 ms, immediate/4.5/>5 second confirmation boundaries, one-arm-one-confirmation, post-confirm START gates, and fresh post-confirm SHUTDOWN safety reads.
known_live_failures.full_cycle_integration_point: The production-like transitional topology uses a 2140 ms pre-arm delay and a separate 2140 ms confirmed Trade Manager safety read during the full OPEN->START->READY->SHUTDOWN->OFFLINE->START->READY lifecycle.

combined_closure_requirement: F001+F002+F003+F004+F005 must pass together in one complete OPEN->START->READY->SHUTDOWN->OFFLINE->START->READY lifecycle.
